fields.label: Apportionment method
fields.value: West Virginia apportions multistate business net income using a single sales factor formula where net business income is multiplied by West Virginia sales divided by sales everywhere.
fields.quote: Under this formula, the numerator includes sales occurring in West Virginia and the denominator includes sales occurring everywhere.

fields.label: Special industry rules
fields.value: Motor carriers apportion income using vehicle mileage, financial organizations use a single factor gross receipts formula, and public utilities may apportion according to accounts prescribed by the Public Service Commission.

fields.label: Forms
fields.value: Multistate corporations compute apportionment on Form CIT-120APT, Schedule B, submitted with Form CIT-120, while combined unitary groups use Schedule UB-4APT or UB-CR.
fields.quote: Neither the numerator nor the denominator of the gross receipts factor should include gross receipts from obligations and certain loans on which you claim the special allowance on Form CIT-120, Schedule B-1.

fields.label: Income/franchise tax nexus
fields.value: West Virginia corporate net income tax applies to corporations engaging in business or deriving income from sources in the state, with no bright-line factor presence threshold for general corporations. For out-of-state financial organizations, nexus is presumed if they solicit business with 20 or more persons in the state or have gross receipts of $100,000 or more from state sources.
fields.quote: A financial organization not having its commercial domicile in West Virginia is presumed to be regularly engaging in business in West Virginia if during any year it obtains or solicits business with 20 or more persons within West Virginia, or the sum of its gross receipts attributable to sources in West Virginia equals or exceeds $100,000.00.

fields.label: Sales/use tax: economic nexus
fields.value: Remote sellers must collect sales and use tax if gross sales into West Virginia exceed $100,000 or if they have 200 or more separate transactions for delivery in the state. The threshold is measured based on the current calendar year or the immediately preceding calendar year.
fields.quote: The Act applies only to sellers that deliver more than $100,000 of goods or services into South Dakota or engage in 200 or more separate transactions for the delivery of goods and services into the State on an annual basis.

fields.label: P.L. 86-272
fields.value: West Virginia recognizes Public Law 86-272 protection against net income tax for out-of-state businesses whose activities within the state are limited to soliciting sales of tangible personal property. Corporate income tax instructions require reporting sales where immunity under Public Law 86-272 applies.

fields.label: Individual income tax
fields.value: Effective for tax year 2026, West Virginia personal income tax rates are reduced to 2.11%, 2.81%, 3.16%, 4.22%, and 4.58%. Married individuals filing separately are subject to the same rates on proportionally reduced bracket thresholds.
fields.quote: Not over $5,000 2.11% of taxable income Over $5,000 but not over $12,500 $105.50 plus 2.81% of excess over $5,000 Over $12,500 but not over $20,000 $316.25 plus 3.16% of excess over $12,500 Over $20,000 but not over $30,000 $553.25 plus 4.22% of excess over $20,000 Over $30,000 $975.25 plus 4.58% of excess over $30,000 Employers The withholding tax tables have been updated for the 2026 tax year.

fields.label: Sales and use tax
fields.value: The state sales and use tax rate is 6.0%. Municipalities may levy an additional local sales and use tax, typically 1%, yielding a total rate of up to 7.0%.

fields.label: Other notable business taxes
fields.value: West Virginia levies a state Business and Occupation gross receipts tax on public service and utility companies, as well as a severance tax including 5.0% on oil, natural gas, and coal gross receipts. Additionally, the state imposes health care provider taxes and a 10% gross receipts tax on medical cannabis dispensaries.
fields.quote: A 5% gross receipts tax also applies to extraction of sand, gravel, limestone, sandstone and any other mineral extracted with the exception of coal , waste coal and timber.

fields.label: Key forms
fields.value: The primary tax returns are Form IT-140 for individuals, Form CIT-120 for corporations, Form PTE-100 for standard pass-through entities, and Form EPT-100 for elective PTET filers.
fields.quote: PENALTY FOR LATE FILING AND FAILURE TO INCLUDE CORRECT INFORMATION Any S Corporation or Partnership that fails to file and/or include all the correct information on Form PTE-100, and on Form WV K-1 or Form NRW-4 when applicable, by the required filing date is subject to a penalty of $50.00 for each information return that they failed to file or include correct information on, not to exceed $100,000.
